seo.title: Mood Easy — Private Mood Tracker for iPhone and Apple Watch
seo.description: A private daily mood check-in. Tap one of five faces, add a note if you like, and watch your Year in pixels fill in. Widgets, Apple Watch and optional Apple Health. No accounts, no tracking.

items.title: One tap a day
items.text: Five faces, from great to awful, each in its own color. One tap checks in and another tap changes it. A short note is there if you want it, with a gentle question to start you off.

items.title: Year in pixels
items.text: Every day of the year is a small square in its mood's color, so patterns show at a glance. Tap any day to see it, change it, or fill in one you missed.

items.title: Insights
items.text: Your mood mix, your average, your current and best streak, weekly and monthly trends, the days that tend to go best, and the words that come up in your notes. Plain numbers, no judgment.

items.title: Widgets
items.text: Check in straight from the medium Home Screen widget, see your week at a glance, or keep today's mood on the Lock Screen.

items.title: Apple Watch
items.text: Check in from your wrist with the same five faces. Your check-in syncs to your iPhone.

items.title: Apple Health
items.text: Optional, on iOS 18 and later: each day's mood is saved to Apple Health as State of Mind. Mood Easy never reads your Health data, and your notes stay in the app.

sections.label: YOUR DATA IS SACRED
sections.title: Mood data is personal. We treat it that way.
text: No accounts. No cloud sync. No analytics. No ads. No tracking. Your check-ins stay on your iPhone and Apple Watch, and in Apple Health only if you turn it on. We never see them. Export them as a CSV file any time.

items.title: Calm colors
items.text: Yellow for great days down to a deep indigo for awful ones. No alarm red: even a hard day should feel okay to write down.

items.title: Plain words
items.text: No emoji, no exclamation marks, no scolding. Mood Easy says how things are and leaves the rest to you.

items.title: No pressure
items.text: One check-in a day, notes optional. The reminder skips days you've already checked in, and a missed day can be filled in later.

cta.title: Start checking in, privately.
cta.text: Free on the App Store. No account required.
